# Susu Ink & Glow

> Brows, lip blush, permanent makeup, fine-line tattoos and piercings by Susu, serving the Columbus, Ohio area. Appointments are requested through the website and confirmed by text.

## Services
- Microblading and microshading
- Lip blush
- Permanent makeup (including eyeliner)
- Fine-line tattoos
- Ear and body piercing
- Eyebrow tint and threading

## Contact
- Website: https://www.susuinkandglow.com/
- Phone / text: (202) 290-6115
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/susuinkandglow/
- Area served: Columbus, Ohio and nearby. The exact appointment location is sent by text when the booking is confirmed.
